title: NVIDIA’s Nemotron hub collects recipes, datasets and end-to-end examples
friendlyTitle: NVIDIA’s Nemotron hub puts model-building examples in one place
summary: The Nemotron repository is NVIDIA’s developer asset hub for its model family, bringing together training and customisation recipes, datasets, evaluation material, skills and full reference workflows. Its notebook-heavy layout is designed to move developers from model exploration to repeatable implementations.
friendlySummary: This repository collects notebooks, datasets, training guides and complete examples for NVIDIA’s Nemotron models. It is meant to help developers move from testing a model to building with it.
whyItMatters: Use it when evaluating or customising Nemotron models and you want maintained examples instead of assembling a workflow from scattered documentation. The included journeys can also serve as reference designs for data curation, fine-tuning and evaluation pipelines.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Start here if you want to customise or evaluate a Nemotron model. The examples can save time and show the main steps of a complete workflow.
